message: ヘレナ・THE・ダイナマイト

name: Synn
message: 「I really don't think we can just keep waiting around.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's gotten into you all of a sudden.」

name: Synn
message: 「I... I'm going to go ask Helena-san!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ask her what, exactly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Because we still haven't heard a single peep from her! About KiraFes...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aaah!! I had nearly forgotten all about that!」

name: Ria
message: 「It'll be fine, Sis is the type who always comes through when it counts.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not that I don't trust her, it's just... when there's complete radio silence like this...」

name: Helena
message: 「'Good morning, members of the Student Council'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!?」

name: Helena
message: 「'Regarding the matter of the Ryuusei Kirakira Festival--'」

name: Synn
message: 「*Gulp*」

name: Helena
message: 「'Furthermore, this tape will self-destruct'」

name: Misa
message: 「That's it?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief. This is hardly the time for jokes, Madam Chairwoman.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmph... Does that mean, after all--」

name: Ria
message: 「--!? Oh no, Everyone get down!」

name: Helena
message: 「Ka-boom! Congratulatiooons!」
Helena-san burst out along with a cloud of explosive smoke.

name: Helena
message: 「The teachers gave the okay.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uuugh...」

name: Helena
message: 「What's with those faces. You could at least act a little happier. After all the hard work you put in.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyuu~」

name: Helena
message: 「Pathetic, getting knocked out by something like that~ Come on, get up! Get up or you'll die!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyuu~」

name: Helena
message: 「Now then, who's next!?」
Before anyone realized it, everyone was awake.

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis! I told you not to use gunpowder anymore because cleaning up afterward is such a pain!」

name: Misa
message: 「You've done this before...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't get so worked up and angry. I just thought a celebratory occasion would be livelier with a little bang.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... does that mean we're allowed to hold it?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes! The extraordinary student general meeting!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Student, general meeting...?」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh. By the way, it's taking place tomorrow morning.」

name: Synn
message: 「Tomorrow...」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm praying for your success.」
